item.description: The Illusion of Randomness in Oil Markets Anyone who trades crude oil futures has seen it happen. Price sells off hard into a round number, stalls, and then snaps violently higher. item.title: Horowitz: Iran’s Defenses Are Broken, Its Retaliatory Power Isn’t
item.description: Iran is bracing for a potential attack as the United States deploys key military assets, including an air carrier and additional bombers, to the Middle East.
